events.title: Nigeria: Axe-Wielding Men Attack Opposition Campaign Rally in Lagos
events.summary: [DW] A group of men armed with axes, clubs and machetes have reportedly attacked an opposition rally in the run-up to presidential elections. Journalists were also attacked as victims pointed fingers at the ruling APC party.

events.title: Nigeria: 7 Die, 11 Injured As Truck Rams Into Commercial Bus On Lagos-Ibadan Expressway
events.summary: [Leadership] Seven people have been killed and 11 others injured in a road accident involving a truck and a commercial bus on the Lagos-Ibadan Expressway.

events.title: Nigeria: Joint Statement By Media and Civil Society Organisations On the Remand of Investigative Journalist Daniel Ojukwu - a Dangerous Attack On Press Freedom and Democratic Accountability
events.summary: [CJID] We demand his immediate release and an end to the criminalisation of investigative journalism.
